The pgx driver is a low-level, high performance interface that exposes PostgreSQL-specific features such as `LISTEN` / `NOTIFY` and `COPY`. It also includes an adapter for the standard `database/sql` interface. The toolkit component is a related set of packages that implement PostgreSQL functionality such as parsing the wire protocol and type mapping between PostgreSQL and Go.
